The ‘My Transition Seminar’ program is open to any CAF member at any point in their career, with spouses/partners and caregivers encouraged to attend. Transition seminars are designed to assist CAF members with their transition from military to civilian life and registration is based on the release item the member is expected to be released under. 

All General Releasing members attend the first day. The Medical Releasing members attend two morning half days. 

Registration is "Open".
